notes.title: Patch 1.03b + hotfix : Reload mechanic improved
notes.notes:
- No more teleport when you hold a gun. It's more easy to release magazine with trackpad
- Solved a bug preventing the release of an object
- Increased the distance to catch a magazine to the belt
